newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA, TURKEY SIGN FREE TRADE DEAL.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA, TURKEY SIGN FREE TRADE DEAL.

text.p: Lithuania and Turkey signed agreements on free trade and cooperation against terrorism, organised crime and drug trafficking on Monday, the first day of Turkish President Suleyman Demirel's two-day visit.
Officials also signed a protocol on cooperation between the Lithuanian and Turkish foreign ministries.
"Our relations are growing fast...these agreements will further our relations," Demirel told reporters as he attended the signing of the documents with Lithuanian President Algirdas Brazauskas.
Brazauskas said Lithuania and Turkey needed to focus in the future on the avoidance of double taxation as well as investment promotion and protection.
